meta.instruction: The player's chosen Primary Attribute (STR, DEX, or INT) determines their starting civilization and quest line.
meta.usage: Ingest the specific key matching the player's stat to retrieve the narrative path.

quests.title: The Collapsing Shaft
quests.narrative_guidance: The main drill shaft at the Command Monolith is buckling. You must stabilize it before the whole city tilts.
improvisation_points: Consult Chief Engineer Hara-Prime for the stabilization schematics.
Secure the support beams from Foreman Kraul at the Gneiss Gates.
Deliver the final calibration codes to Technician Lorn-Seven to seal the shaft.

quests.title: Rad-Safe Routing
quests.narrative_guidance: A surge of radiation has blocked the transport lines. A new path must be mapped using secure codes.
improvisation_points: Obtain the encrypted bypass logic from AI Core-11.A.
Scan for safe pockets with Radiation Scout Iko-Red in the Gantry Row.
Hand the verified coordinates to Drone Commander R-Delta-V to update the drone paths.

quests.title: The Black-Market Batch
quests.narrative_guidance: Rare ore has gone missing from the foundry. It needs to be moved to a buyer without the Overseer knowing.
improvisation_points: Accept the hidden stash from Salvager Xyra-One.
Stash the ore in the reclamation pit with Scrap King Jax.
Bribe Grease Monkey Sly to smuggle it through the corridors.

quests.title: Atmospheric Integrity
quests.narrative_guidance: The Welders' Habitats are losing oxygen pressure. Repairs must be expedited.
improvisation_points: Collect a requisition order from Habitat Warden Jace.
Secure the refined gas canisters from Refinery Op Mara.
Install the seals at the spare-part vaults under the eye of Vault Guard Drax.

quests.title: Hydraulic Overload
quests.narrative_guidance: A hydraulic leak is threatening the chassis forge. Someone needs to crawl into the ducts.
improvisation_points: Get the leak locations from Duct Crawler Pip.
Acquire the custom-welded patch from Forge Master Bran.
Ensure the waste valves are cleared by Slag Monitor Nox.

quests.title: Magma Flow Regulation
quests.narrative_guidance: The geothermal intake is running too hot. The turbines are at risk of melting.
improvisation_points: Receive the flow-gate keys from Intake Guard Vol.
Calculate the cooling dispersal with Heat Analyst Sora.
Apply the radiation dampeners with Lead Shield Tavish.

quests.title: The Deep Anchor Protocol
quests.narrative_guidance: The base is shifting on the sub-crustal plates. The anchors must be reinforced with crushed quartz.
improvisation_points: Collect the heavy material from Mill Hand Grog.
Power up the anchor-winches with Turbine Tech Elara.
Deliver the status report to Anchor Master Silas at the anchor points.

quests.title: The Unstable Shaft
quests.narrative_guidance: A primary drill shaft in Helix Hub is vibrating out of tolerance, threatening a sector-wide collapse.
improvisation_points: Obtain the stabilization harmonics from Chief Hara-V1.
Take the harmonics to Tech Lorn-Beta in Caliper Reach to calibrate the drill bits.
Upload the final calibration to Logic Core Gamma at Vector Point to synchronize the planetary rotation.

quests.title: Radiation Ghosting
quests.narrative_guidance: Ghost signals in the radiation sensors are causing drones to malfunction and attack personnel.
improvisation_points: Receive the anomalous sensor logs from Scout Iko-S.
Deliver the logs to Unit Delta-Prime to patch the drone sub-routines.
Present the success report to Overseer Melen-Z to avoid a sector lockdown.

quests.title: The Locked Archive
quests.narrative_guidance: Valuable mineral data has been locked behind a security firewall that Logic Core Beta cannot bypass alone.
improvisation_points: Acquire the decryption bypass from Scrapper Xy-8 in the Thermal Shield Spires.
Interface with Logic Core Beta to input the bypass code.
Deliver the decrypted data to Chief Hara-V2 to optimize furnace output.

quests.title: The Dark Ore Heist
quests.narrative_guidance: A rare vein of shadow-ore has been found, but the Cartel hasn't authorized its extraction.
improvisation_points: Meet Scrapper Xy-9 to receive the stealth extraction kit.
Have Tech Lorn-Gamma mask the seismic signatures during the dig.
Hand off the ore to Scout Iko-U at the Final Sump for smuggling.

quests.title: The Compliance Audit
quests.narrative_guidance: A high-level inspection is coming, and several safety violations need to be 'corrected' or hidden.
improvisation_points: Collect the violation list from Overseer Melen-Y.
Task Unit Delta-Secundus with emergency cosmetic repairs to the steam vents.
Submit the falsified safety logs to Logic Core Alpha for archiving.

quests.title: Torque Calibration
quests.narrative_guidance: The torque ridge is slipping, and the mechanical drones are failing to maintain the grip.
improvisation_points: Receive the torque requirements from Unit Delta-Tertius.
Consult Tech Lorn-Alpha for the ancient drilling codes required for the override.
Deliver the override confirmation to Chief Hara-V3 to lock the tethers.

quests.title: The Silent Signal
quests.narrative_guidance: An invisible hazard has been detected in the Signal Silence region that is disrupting communications.
improvisation_points: Get the hazard coordinates from Scout Iko-T.
Use Overseer Melen-X's authority to clear the area of unauthorized personnel.
Trade the recovered hazard data to Scrapper Xy-7 for tech upgrades.

quests.title: The Deep Shaft Crisis
quests.narrative_guidance: A major drill shaft in Bore-Site Alpha is nearing structural collapse due to unforeseen seismic activity.
improvisation_points: Obtain heavy drilling equipment from Driller Bor.
Calibrate the seismic dampeners with Stabilizer Jax to halt the tremors.
Finalize the structural seal at Maintenance Pod C-7 with Fixer Zen.

quests.title: The Rad-Leak Extraction
quests.narrative_guidance: An emergency in the pods requires an immediate extraction of sensitive materials through a high-radiation zone.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the medical hazard list from Med-Unit Gamma.
Use the sensor array to map the safest path with Watcher Iko-Beta.
Deliver the protected materials to Mechanic Lorn-S for decontamination.

quests.title: Logic Core Override
quests.narrative_guidance: The Synod requires a manual bypass of local AI restrictions to access mineral yield projections.
improvisation_points: Acquire the decryption keys from Logician Kael.
Broadcast the bypass signal through Transmit-Unit 7's relay.
Verify the kinetic power draw with Spin-Tech Tor to hide the data surge.

quests.title: Slag-Heap Scavenging
quests.narrative_guidance: Valuable ores have been misplaced in the waste piles, and they must be recovered without triggering alarms.
improvisation_points: Identify the missing ore signatures with Scrapper Xyra-Z.
Bypass the power grid sensors with Spark-Tech Jule.
Record the recovery as 'logistical error' with Orator Vex.

quests.title: Operational Compliance Check
quests.narrative_guidance: The Synod demands a full report on the mechanical integrity of the Bore-Site's primary systems.
improvisation_points: Secure the perimeter reports from Guard 01-B.
Analyze the lubrication viscosity data with Lube-Tech Pip.
Submit the final compliance certificate to Polisher Lux for archiving.

quests.title: The Drone Reroute
quests.narrative_guidance: Automated maintenance drones are ignoring a critical gear-tooth failure that could stall the entire site.
improvisation_points: Redirect the assembly drone swarm via Assembly-Drone R-D1.
Clean the air intake pathways with Filter-Unit Phi to prevent drone overheating.
Coordinate the final gear replacement with Machinist Cog.

quests.title: Radiance Mapping
quests.narrative_guidance: Anomalies in the stellar thermal radiation are affecting the Vent-Spires' energy absorption.
improvisation_points: Collect initial anomaly data from Watcher Iko-Beta.
Cross-reference the stellar coordinates with Star-Gazer Ren.
Adjust the heat-exchange valves with Vent-Master Kel to compensate.
